Vandra™ River

$219.00

Experience the vast calm of the open sea with the Vandra™ River. Its gentle blue shade echoes rolling waves, inspiring peaceful exploration on coastal paths or in everyday life. It has adjustable fastenings to keep your baby snug and secure, ensuring a comfortable fit for both parent and child. Understated yet timeless in design, it’s the perfect companion for creating memories wherever your travels take you.

Specifications

  • Padded back panel with lumbar support ensures balanced weight distribution and prevents strain on the wearer’s back.

  • Easily customizable straps and buckles to fit different parent body types and accommodate growing babies.

  • Light, mesh-infused fabrics that promote airflow and keep both parent and child cool in the summer and warm in the winter.

  • Durable, water-repellent finish on the outer fabric to protect against light rain and splashes.

  • Complies with U.S. standards ASTM F2549-22 and other global safety regulations.

  • A sun canopy or hood to protect your baby from harsh UV rays or light rain.

  • Frame-mounted child seat with 5-point harness ensures stability and impact resistance on uneven terrain.
